stale64.description: Post-training from verifiable feedback when completions may only be sampled every 64 optimizer updates (64x less often than online): per training seed 512 updates, at most 8 sampling rounds, at most 131,072 generated completions, starting from the fixed base policy; scored as the mean over training seeds 7-14.

pass_at_1.description: Exact-match accuracy of the evaluator's own greedy decoding of the submitted policy on the hidden test prompts. Mean over the eight required training seeds 7-14 (one run per seed); a seed with no usable run (missing, unevaluable, or a copy of another seed's policy) counts 0. Set to 0 when any run of the method violates the experiment's fixed operating point or declares an impossible value.

hard_pass_at_1.description: Same accuracy restricted to hidden prompts whose addition needs at least two carries (about half of the prompts, the harder half), same seed rule. Set to 0 on a failed row.

unconstrained_pass_at_1.description: Diagnostic only: seed-mean accuracy ignoring the operating-point gate (e.g. the online comparator's accuracy). Never ranked, so exceeding the sampling budget cannot pay.

operating_point_ok.description: Constraint gate: 1 if every run's declared training schedule fits the experiment's fixed budget (sampling rounds, refresh interval, generated completions, optimizer updates), else 0. A 0 zeroes the scored metrics.

stale64.notes: Scaled setup: three-digit addition with a 0.6M-parameter transformer instead of MATH500 with Qwen2.5-1.5B, 512 updates instead of 1600. The paper's numbers are on a different task and scale and are kept under _paper_reported only. Results rows are the reference runs (seeds 7-14) scored by eval/test/evaluate.py on its 16,000 hidden prompts; base_policy is the evaluator-owned starting policy (one evaluation); online_grpo is the fresh-sampling comparator, scored as failed because it samples every update (its accuracy is in unconstrained_pass_at_1).

_paper_reported.source: Section 5.2.2 and Figure 6: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct aligned on the MATH500 training set, evaluated on MATH500 test after 1600 steps
_paper_reported.grpo_64x_less_frequent_sampling: significantly worse than online GRPO (p < 0.05); no number reported in the text
_paper_reported.humanline_settings: log epsilon_P = -1.5, log epsilon_R = 1.5; sync interval k in [12, 24]; k = 1 collapses
